extraction.name: arabic-img2md and arabic-books
extraction.description: A synthetic dataset, arabic-img2md, consisting of 13.7k paired samples of Arabic book pages and their Markdown representations, and arabic-books, a large-scale dataset of 1.1 billion Arabic tokens extracted from over 8,500 books.
extraction.creator: Mohamed A. Rashad
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Generated by scraping HTML content from the Hindawi website, converting it to PDFs, and extracting Markdown text.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: HTML scraped from the Hindawi website
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Converting scraped HTML content to PDFs, and extracting Markdown text to create paired samples.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Data pairs were generated by scraping HTML content from the Hindawi website, converting it to PDFs, and extracting Markdown text. For model input, images are progressively downsampled from 896x672 pixels to 28x21 pixels.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Promotes the digitization of underrepresented languages like Arabic.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset is derived from Hindawi's web content and may not generalize well to other domains of Arabic text, such as scientific, religious, or historical documents.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Models trained on the dataset exhibit hallucination and repetition issues. The dataset may not generalize to scientific, religious, or historical documents, and models may struggle with highly irregular or multi-modal layouts.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training and evaluation of Arabic OCR models, and downstream NLP tasks.
